children: Algeria’s state-owned Sonatrach will carry out a technical review of a feasibility study for the development of Niger’s Bilma oil block, which is expected to produce more than 20,000 barrels per day (bpd), according to a report by local Arabic language news portal Echorouk Online.

The review will serve as a preliminary step towards preparing a field development plan for the block, which is located in Niger’s Diffa region and extends towards Agadez, the report published last week said.
The feasibility study envisages production of more than 20,000 bpd over a 20-year period, the report said.
(Writing by Majda Muhsen; Editing by Anoop Menon)
